Name: Chemical Agent Instructor Course
Short description: December 14 – 18, 2026 · Miramar, San Diego, CA · 40 Hours · POST certified · AB 48 compliant · Plan IV reimbursable.
Description:
Course Overview

The Chemical Agent Instructor Course is a 40-hour, California POST-certified instructor course that prepares officers to teach, deploy and document chemical agents safely, lawfully and effectively. Taught by instructors who were — and in many cases still are — law enforcement tactical operators.

Southwestern Solutions Chemical Agent and Less Lethal Instructor Courses meet AB 48 requirements and are POST certified. AB 48 / PC 13652 will be taught in this course.

What You Will Learn

  • Review of use of force and related agency policies
  • Deployment techniques and munition selection
  • Use of the protective mask (fit, inspection, clearing, confidence exercises)
  • Use of chemical agent munitions and delivery systems
  • Decontamination, medical considerations and aftercare
  • Instruction techniques and lesson-plan development
  • Scenario exercises, including AB 48 / Penal Code 13652 requirements

Course Details

DatesDecember 14 – 18, 2026
LocationMiramar, San Diego, CA
Length40 Hours (instructor level)
Tuition$1,881 per seat
CertificationCalifornia POST certified
ReimbursementPOST Plan IV (tuition only — no travel or per diem)
ComplianceAB 48 / Penal Code 13652

What to Bring

  • Department-issued ID and POST ID number
  • Serviceable protective (gas) mask
  • Duty or training gear and clothing suitable for outdoor practical exercises
  • Eye and ear protection
  • Notebook and pen

A detailed equipment list and reporting instructions are emailed after registration.

Registration

Select the number of seats and click Register Now. At checkout, enter your agency and each attendee’s name and POST ID. Agencies paying by purchase order or needing an invoice can contact us or call +1 (928) 614-0964.

Frequently Asked Questions

Is this course POST Plan IV reimbursable?

Yes. The course is California POST certified and Plan IV reimbursable (tuition). Travel and per diem are not reimbursed under Plan IV.

Does the course cover AB 48?

Yes. AB 48 / Penal Code 13652 requirements are covered so your instructors can carry compliant lesson plans and documentation back to the agency.

Can I register several officers?

Yes. Increase the number of seats before adding the course to your cart, then list every attendee at checkout.
